in_marathi.name: Nivan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nivan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'niv' which means 'to conquer' or 'to gain victory over'. It is a name of great significance in Hindu mythology, given to a child born into a victorious family or as a symbol of triumph over adversity. The name is also associated with the god Vishnu, who is believed to grant victory and protect his devotees.
